title: Protein-nanoparticle interactions
summary: We investigate how proteins adsorb, unfold, and interact with various nanoparticle surfaces at the atomistic level to understand their biological impact.

title: Drug delivery systems
summary: Design and computational evaluation of novel nanocarriers for targeted drug delivery, focusing on molecular stability and release mechanisms.

title: Advanced biomaterial design
summary: Applying multiscale modeling techniques to develop advanced biomaterials with specific mechanical and chemical properties for tissue engineering.
